import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtSeparated
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

#check @CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
#check @AlgebraicGeometry.IsSeparated

-- ORIENTATION: what is the type of the hypothesis morphism of locallyOfFiniteType_of_baseChange?
section Orient
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
#check (Limits.pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) X.hom)
example : (Limits.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) X.hom
    ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k')) :=
  Limits.pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) X.hom
end Orient

-- DESCENT ABSENCE: is DescendsAlong @IsSeparated really absent?
example : MorphismProperty.DescendsAlong (@IsSeparated)
    (@Surjective ⊓ @Flat ⊓ @QuasiCompact : MorphismProperty Scheme) := by
  infer_instance
